probe_policy.purpose: tiny Responses error-classification and accounting gate before any full Sol benchmark request
probe_policy.error_handling: any object or scalar error envelope stops before the full benchmark; retain HTTP status, safe type/code/param/status fields, hash/length and allowlisted integration markers only
probe_policy.missing_usage_behavior: stop before the full benchmark call and mark spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled unless exact usage is present

accounting_policy.successful_live_envelope: record exact recursively discovered usage and estimated cost before visible-final-text parsing
accounting_policy.error_envelope: never proceed to full benchmark; account exact usage if the error envelope exposes it, otherwise keep run spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled
accounting_policy.arbitrary_error_text: never retain raw provider error strings; retain only SHA-256, length and allowlisted diagnostic markers

scope: freeze and reuse all four scored observations; issue only a tiny Sol Responses probe; classify error-only envelopes without retaining arbitrary text; proceed to the full Sol benchmark request only if the probe returns no API error and exposes exact token usage; never repurchase Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek or Kimi
architecture_snapshot_policy: retain the same canonical ACCB-DEV-001 snapshot used by the first four scores so a later fifth score remains directly comparable; A/B/C/D expansion is a later preregistered tranche
provider_policy: pin the OpenAI endpoint tag; allow_fallbacks=false; record actual provider metadata returned by RouterAI
transport_policy: GPT-5.6 Sol follows the runtime endpoint-declared Responses transport; only visible final-answer fields may become candidate output; provider reasoning/thinking and arbitrary provider error text are never retained
admission_policy: Sol must expose a healthy Responses endpoint >=128K and positive parseable pricing; the existing <=100 RUB upper bound remains, and the tiny probe must return no error plus exact token usage before any expensive live request is permitted
scientific_boundary: fifth-model low-context calibration/integration evidence only; no universal ECC/AMCE threshold inference
